meta.title: STARBONDS — The social network for artists
meta.description: Show your art, sell it, and find artists to collaborate with.

landing.eyebrow: For artists who deserve to be seen
landing.subtitle: The social network where emerging artists show their work, sell it without middlemen, and match with other artists to create together.
landing.howSubtitle: Three tools, one community of artists.
landing.f1Body: The Discover feed lifts up people who are just starting out, not only those with thousands of followers.
landing.f2Body: List artworks and commissioned services, and talk directly with buyers.
landing.f3Body: Pick your mediums, styles, and goals, and find like-minded artists to collaborate with.
landing.matchBody: We show you artists who share your mediums, styles, and goals. If you both say yes, a chat opens so you can start collaborating.
landing.matchPoint1: Shared goals matter more than fame
landing.matchPoint2: Chats only open when interest is mutual
landing.matchPoint3: Block or report in one tap

plei.petLabel: Plei, your star guide. Tap for a tip.
plei.intro: Hi! I'm Plei, named after the Pleiades. I'll help you find your constellation of artists.
tips: Swipe right to connect and left to pass.
Shared goals weigh more in your matches.
Add work to your portfolio: it shines on your card.
Every artist is a star. Together you form constellations.
The Pleiades are a cluster of young stars. Just like you.
If you both say yes, a chat opens so you can collaborate.
plei.liked: Great pick! If they pick you too, you'll shine together.
plei.passed: No worries, there are plenty more stars.
plei.matched: A new constellation! Say hi soon.
plei.empty: You've seen everyone for today. Time for a nap… come back tomorrow.
